summary: Verified P1 shared ABC Place Order contract. Ran unit contract suite (test_abc_place_order_contract.py: 15 tests), legacy direct-mock suite (test_abc_supply_p3.py: 7 tests), and all sibling ABC regression suites (order_comments, delivery_appointment, delivery_instructions_routing, delivery_services_enum, po_setup_warning, po_jobmaterialplan_body, cancel_guard, orderability_preflight = 83 tests) - all pass. Added new HTTP-level test file test_abc_mock_strictness_http.py (14 tests) that hits the real public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL /api/abc-mock/api/order/v2/orders endpoint with OAuth token to independently confirm the mock server now uses the shared validate_place_order and rejects every historical wrong shape (WCL/OTB/ZZZ deliveryService, bare `comments` string, list/string line comments, dates.deliveryAppointmentTime, bad appointment code, ST-without-fromTime, TR-without-toTime, instructions>255, missing shipTo.number, purchaseOrder>20 chars) with HTTP 400 and returns 200+MOCK-CONF-* for a documented valid order. End-to-end abc-submit happy path validated via test_abc_supply_delivery_api.py (7 passed / 1 skipped) - proves production payload builder passes the same validator (defense-in-depth did not break happy path).
critical_code_review_comments: place_order_contract.py is clean, small (~120 lines), single-sourced from orders.DELIVERY_SERVICE_CODES, versioned (CONTRACT_VERSION='2025-05'). Good separation: _validate_structure / _validate_comments / _validate_appointment.
Both the mock (mock_server.place_order_mock) and production (routers/purchasing.py abc_submit) call the same validate_place_order, satisfying the 'cannot drift' invariant.

Minor: validate_place_order collects structural errors as a list but appends comment/appointment errors only as single strings at the end. Acceptable given the current mock returns first error; could be broadened later without breaking callers.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_abc_mock_strictness_http.py (new - independent HTTP-level regression suite for the mock strictness contract)

success_rate.backend: 100% (127/127 across contract + regression + new HTTP suite; delivery API 7 passed / 1 pre-existing skip)

test_credentials: Used mock OAuth (/api/abc-mock/oauth2/v1/token, client_credentials); no owner login required for the mock-strictness suite.
seed_data_creation: None - tests use uuid-based requestId and purchaseOrder to avoid collisions with in-memory mock state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Shared ABC Place Order contract lives at backend/integrations/abc_supply/place_order_contract.py. Unit tests: tests/test_abc_place_order_contract.py. HTTP-level mock-strictness tests I added: tests/test_abc_mock_strictness_http.py (hits /api/abc-mock/api/order/v2/orders via REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL after mock OAuth). Run ABC suites single-worker: pytest -o addopts=''. Do NOT weaken the contract - it rejects (by design) OTB/WCL, bare `comments`, dates.deliveryAppointmentTime, string/list line comments.
rca of the issue: N/A - this iteration was verification of the P1 refactor, not a bug fix. All assertions from the review request confirmed: (a) unit contract accepts documented shapes and rejects every wrong shape enumerated; (b) mock now rejects the same shapes at HTTP layer (previously WCL/OTB would have passed); (c) end-to-end abc-submit still yields MOCK-CONF-* so defense-in-depth did not regress happy path; (d) all 8 sibling ABC regression suites still green.
